settings.general.title: General
settings.general.turnCounterOn: The turn number shows top right during a match. Drag the box to move it, its corner to resize.
settings.general.assembleOn: Drag the lobby types box, the sidebar or the turn counter against one another and they join into one panel. Right-click it to take it apart.
settings.trinkets.title: Trinket HUD
settings.anomaly.title: Anomaly HUD
settings.anomaly.intro: The Trinket HUD's counterpart for the lobby anomaly: an always-on card for stream viewers on phones or without the Twitch extension. It does nothing until anomalies are back in the game.
settings.mmr.title: Portrait/Sidebar overlay
settings.darkGifts.title: Dark Gifts
settings.boards.label: Opponents' last boards
settings.boards.intro: Hover a leaderboard portrait to see the board that player last fought you with, and the turn it is from. Rest the cursor on a minion to open its card.
settings.boards.pin: Click a portrait to keep its board open
settings.boards.pinOn: A click on a portrait keeps its board open. Click the portrait again, or the board itself, to close it.
settings.boards.pinOff: Boards show only while the cursor is on a portrait.
settings.lobbyTribes.label: Lobby minion types box
settings.lobbyTribes.on: The lobby's minion types stay on screen for the whole match. Drag the box to move it, its corner to resize.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.cardSearch.intro: Click a binding, then press the key to assign. Esc cancels; Alt can't be bound. Reusing a key moves it here and unbinds its previous owner.
settings.cardSearch.searchButton: In-game search button (by the card list)
settings.cardSearch.searchButtonOn: Magnifying glass next to the game's card-list book toggles the search.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromDetailOn: Drag the detail portrait to pull out a floating card.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromGridOn: Drag a grid card to pull out a floating card.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromGridOff: Grid drag-out off (a grid click just selects).
settings.cardSearch.hideDraggedWithAppOn: Dragged cards hide with the overlay.
settings.cardSearch.hideDraggedWithAppOf: Dragged cards stay on screen when the overlay closes.
settings.trinkets.intro: Mostly for streamers: an always-on panel of your trinkets, for viewers on phones or without access to the Twitch extension. A box appears for each trinket you hold — usually two, but several lesser trinkets end up as a second greater one and anomalies can hand out more, so up to four boxes are available to position.
settings.trinkets.footer: In match: right-click a trinket card to close it until the match ends, or turn the HUD off.
settings.anomaly.footer: In match: right-click the anomaly card to close it until the match ends, or turn the HUD off.
settings.mmr.mmrPortraitsHint: Rating by each leaderboard portrait only (8000↓ below the leaderboard cutoff).
settings.mmr.mmrPanelHint: Rating inside the sidebar only (8000↓ below the leaderboard cutoff).
settings.mmr.mmrBothHint: Rating by the portraits and in the sidebar (8000↓ below the leaderboard cutoff).
settings.mmr.namesPortraitsHint: Names by each leaderboard portrait only.
settings.mmr.namesBothHint: Names by the portraits and in the sidebar.
settings.mmr.nameTypeBattletagsHint: Each opponent's battletag, wherever names show.
settings.mmr.nameTypeHeroesHint: The hero's name instead of the battletag — nothing identifies the player.
settings.mmr.deltasOn: Daily ▲/▼ deltas shown next to the rating.
settings.mmr.tiersBothHint: Tier icons by the portraits and in the sidebar.
settings.mmr.tiersPortraitsHint: Tier icons right of each leaderboard portrait only.
settings.mmr.tiersPanelHint: Tier icons inside the sidebar only.
settings.mmr.typesBothHint: Each player's most common minion type — under the tier icon by the portrait, and in the sidebar.
settings.mmr.typesPortraitsHint: Type icon under each leaderboard portrait's tier icon only.
settings.mmr.typesPanelHint: Type icon inside the sidebar only.
settings.mmr.lastOpponentOn: The previous combat's opponent gets a ⚔ marker by their portrait.
settings.darkGifts.intro: What the panel shows. Right-clicking the panel in game cycles these too.
settings.darkGifts.modeBothDesc: The full panel — gifts, plus the guaranteed-type minions when they apply.
settings.darkGifts.modeMinionsDesc: Only the guaranteed-type minion arts; the panel stays hidden when no pool applies.
settings.darkGifts.poolCount: Max amount of minions to show
settings.darkGifts.poolZeroHint: The guaranteed tribe is named; none of its minions are drawn.
settings.darkGifts.poolHint: At most {0} of the guaranteed tribe's minions, sole gift-enablers first. Fewer when its pool is smaller.
settings.darkGifts.footer: In match: a “?” sits above the Dark Discovery button — click it and the panel opens in the top-right corner. Close it with the ✕ or a click anywhere else. Scroll it with the wheel; right-click it to cycle these modes.
settings.updates.availableText: Update v{0} is available. Download the installer and run it: it closes Hearthstone Deck Tracker, replaces the plugin files and can start HDT again. The release notes are on the release page.
settings.common.arrangeHint: Brings Hearthstone to the front and shows just this, on its own. Drag it to move; drag its top-right corner to resize. Click Done here when it's where you want it.
settings.common.hsNotRunningDetail:
Hearthstone isn't running.

This draws on top of the game, so there is nothing to position yet. Start Hearthstone, then click Arrange again.
settings.common.arranging: Arranging — drag it to move, drag its top-right corner to resize. Click Done when finished.
settings.cardSearch.artFolderDialog: Choose a folder for the card-art cache (~200 MB). A '{0}' subfolder is created there.
settings.cardSearch.artFolderMoving: Moving card art… (may take a moment across drives)
settings.cardSearch.artFolderFailed: Couldn't move card art: {0} — kept current folder.
settings.cardSearch.listening: Listening for a key... (Esc to cancel)
settings.cardSearch.altNotBindable: Alt can't be bound - press another key.
settings.language.intro: Card names, text and art, the words the search understands, and the plugin's own menus and messages. Switching downloads nothing by itself: a language's card data (about 1 MB) is fetched the first time it is used. The plugin's own texts are machine-translated — corrections are welcome.
settings.language.autoRowHint: Follows HDT's language setting — {0} right now.
settings.language.status.pending: Card data: {0} — about 1 MB downloads the first time the search opens or a match starts; English until then.
settings.language.status.empty: Card data: {0} — hsbg.cards has no translation for it yet; English shown.
settings.autostart.label: Start with Windows
settings.autostart.hint: Waits in the tray, using next to nothing, until Hearthstone starts; then the toolkit comes up and closes again with the game.
settings.autostart.off: Does not start with Windows: start it from its shortcut.
standalone.tray.waiting: Tantrum's BG Toolkit: waiting for Hearthstone
standalone.bothRunning: Hearthstone Deck Tracker is running this toolkit's plugin too, so everything shows twice. Switch the plugin off in HDT (Options > Tracker > Plugins) or exit this program from its tray icon.
plugin.bothRunning: The standalone Tantrum's Battlegrounds Toolkit is running too, so everything shows twice. Exit it from its tray icon, or switch this plugin off under Options > Tracker > Plugins.

settings.config.title: Config
settings.config.warning: Only import a config from someone you trust completely. The file is checked before anything is applied, but a check can be outsmarted.
settings.config.shareHint: An exported file holds your switches, hotkeys and the places and sizes of the boxes. It never holds folders, your language or anything about updates.
settings.config.presetNameBad: A preset name is 1 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, - or _.
settings.config.presetFull: Couldn't save the preset (30 at most).
settings.config.err.type: Not imported: that is not a toolkit config file (.tbtconfig).
settings.config.err.size: Not imported: the file is empty or too large to be a config.
settings.config.err.bytes: Not imported: the file holds data a config never has.
settings.config.err.xml: Not imported: the file is not a toolkit config.
settings.config.err.newer: Not imported: the file comes from a newer version of the toolkit.
settings.config.err.content: Not imported: "{0}" is not a setting, or holds a value it can't have.
settings.config.err.read: Not imported: couldn't read the file.
settings.tools.title: BepInEx mods
settings.tools.intro: Each mod is installed by its own Setup, which also adds BepInEx if it's missing. Download opens the Setup in your browser.
settings.tools.failed: Couldn't load the list. Check your connection, or see every tool on the website.
settings.tools.risk.mod: Mods are a gray zone: Blizzard doesn't approve of them and they're technically against its EULA, but we know of no bans for using them. Use them at your own risk.
settings.tools.risk.thirdParty: Made by {0}, not by this toolkit's author. We don't check its code, so install it only if you trust its author.
settings.tools.desc.replayWatcher: Records your Battlegrounds games and plays them back inside Hearthstone, with a timeline and up to x4 speed.
settings.tools.desc.deckInspector: Pick up a deck from the board and turn it around: yours or your opponent's.
settings.tools.desc.friendSearch: Adds a search bar to Hearthstone's friends list. Typos are forgiven.
settings.tools.noHearthstone: Hearthstone wasn't found on this PC.
settings.tools.noBepInEx: BepInEx isn't in Hearthstone's folder, so there are no mods yet. The Setups of our mods add it along with the mod.
settings.tools.noMods: No mods in the BepInEx folder.
settings.tools.deleteHint: Delete moves the mod's file to the Recycle Bin. A mod that came with a Setup is better removed from Windows Settings → Apps, which also removes the rest of its files.
settings.tools.status.notInCatalogue: Not in the catalogue, so its updates can't be checked here.
settings.tools.deleteConfirm:
Move {0} ({1}) to the Recycle Bin?

Hearthstone has to be closed for this. If the mod came with a Setup, uninstalling it from Windows Settings → Apps is cleaner.
settings.tools.deleteFailed:
Couldn't delete {0}: {1}

If Hearthstone is running, close it and try again.
